verification_note: Reconciled all 64 detailed English outline bullets from 'Skills measured as of April 16, 2026' bidirectionally in domain order (16/16/16/8/8), one objective per bullet. Locators use the domain, the unique skill-group heading, and a short exact bullet anchor. Every named technology, operation, and constraint in compound bullets is represented as its own subskill; derived=true marks instructional decomposition, not extra official bullets. Domain weights match 'Skills at a glance'. The guide's boilerplate says two outline versions may appear, but on 2026-10-07 the page contained only the April 16, 2026 version; no future effective outline was found. Page metadata ms.date 2026-03-31 and updated_at 2026-07-07 are publication metadata, not an effective date. Passing score 700 per the guide's scoring link. AI-103 earns Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate, the prerequisite for AI-500. Verification is of published outline coverage, not service behavior, preview availability, or unpublished exam content.
